dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MARINERS WIN THRILLER IN BALTIMORE, DODGERS DOMINATE**

The Seattle Mariners edged the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 in a back-and-forth contest, with Randy Arozarena leading the charge with three hits, one home run, and three RBIs. Logan Gilbert pitched six strong innings, allowing just one earned run and striking out five. In a separate game, the Los Angeles Dodgers routed the Pittsburgh Pirates 12-3, with Andy Pages hitting a home run and driving in three runs. Paul Skenes was dominant on the mound, striking out seven in six innings.

Meanwhile, the Tampa Bay Rays narrowly defeated the Boston Red Sox 4-3, with Marcelo Mayer delivering a crucial double and driving in two runs. The Detroit Tigers crushed the Minnesota Twins 10-4, with Dillon Dingler hitting two home runs and driving in four runs. The Miami Marlins also won big, defeating the Arizona Diamondbacks 10-6, with Corbin Carroll hitting a home run and driving in two runs.
